title: Defender Controlled Folder Access (CFA) Anti-Ransomware Shielding is Disabled
description: Controlled Folder Access intercepts and blocks unauthorized processes from modifying, encrypting, or overwriting files in protected directories.
impact: Unmonitored ransomware execution can rapidly encrypt user documents, desktop items, and local databases.
remediation_guidance: Enable Defender Controlled Folder Access in Block mode via PowerShell or Group Policy.

check_params.subkey: SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Controlled Folder Access

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure Controlled Folder Access is Enabled

title: Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) Deletion Protection & System Restore Disabled
description: Modern ransomware strains proactively delete Volume Shadow Copies via 'vssadmin delete shadows' and 'wmic shadowcopy delete' to eliminate unassisted file recovery.
expected: VSS Service Configured and System Restore Active on OS Drive
impact: In the event of ransomware encryption or disk compromise, point-in-time snapshot recovery is impossible.
remediation_guidance: Enable System Restore on OS drive and restrict VSSAdmin execution to SYSTEM/elevated administrators.

compliance_mappings.title: Configure System Restore and Shadow Storage
